per_candidate.id: s2:Emission Spectra of Galaxies with Supermassive Black Holes at z > 6
s2:Formation of Supermassive Stars and the Direct Collapse to Black Holes

rationale: Several direct candidates, such as 2504.18144 and 2601.14395, provide new insights into the mechanisms of black hole growth in the early Universe, contributing evidence relevant to the formation of SMBHs and IMBHs. However, the question remains partially addressed as not all aspects are settled.
